description: A bearded man in a tall cylindrical crown and a black robe with gold embroidery and tasselled fringes stands centre frame, with a bow case and arrows on his back and a dagger at his waist. Behind him, winged human-headed bull statues flank a stone hall lit by torches and candles. On the left, a stack of clay tablets marked with wedge script sits on a table. Several bearded men in long robes bow or kneel on both sides of the hall.
